utterances.text: You need to cut your nails.
Shut up, I don't know how to do everything else with my damn nails.
You going to take forever texting and calling. I can't sit and show you all the time. I bought you a phone before, you don't know how to use it.
Wait, I am trying to understand the 'swipe' motion you mentioned. Does it start from the bottom edge or the middle?
Just do it! It's not that hard, you're just overthinking it because you're scared of the screen. My hands just do it naturally, I don't know why you're struggling with a basic gesture.
Stop yelling and listen! I'm telling you my finger doesn't register because of the nail. Don't tell me I'm scared when the machine is the one not working.
I'm not yelling, I'm just telling you the right way. Now swipe up. No, faster. Do it again. Just follow my hand and stop pausing.

I was going to ask about the icons, but you just keep barking 'swipe' at me. I feel like I can't even touch the thing without you snapping. I’m putting this down until you let me speak a full sentence.
I did buy you an iPhone, you ain't know how to use it.
This ain't no iPhone.
I know, it's Android. I don't like them.
All I need is a phone.
Let me cut your nails. So you can use the phone correctly Hey, do what you do. Do how you tap, tap the phone.

All right. Okay.

H. How you spell hey? Hey .

Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey!
It's H-E-Y.
Hey! No, hey is H-A-Y. All right, I'm gonna let you be the— The E is silent. That's the way you saying it. Hey! H-A-Y.
